title: Lobatto4: the index-3 constraints at the end of the step without GGL, and the automatic step size by the embedded trapezoidal solution
author: Claude-JG
description: SolveLobatto4 enforces the constraints with the GGL stabilization at every implicit stage and has constant steps only. Decided: the 3-stage Lobatto methods with the constraints only at the end of the step, as the maintainer remembers from HOTINT, tried for IIIA, IIIB and IIIC; the automatic step size by the embedded trapezoidal solution first (revision2026c step RG20.2.3).
releaseNotes: SolveLobatto4 of exudyn.symbolics.advancedSolvers has the variants 'IIIA-end' (the default) and 'IIIC-end', which enforce the constraints and the velocity constraints at the end of the step only, with a multiplier per stage after the start, of order 4 in the coordinates and velocities, beside 'IIIA-GGL' and 'IIIC-GGL'; the variant 'IIIC' with the constraints at all stages is removed. With timeIntegration.automaticStepSize the step size follows the difference to the embedded trapezoidal solution, with the PI controller of SolveTrapezoidalGGL; this estimate of order 2 keeps the error far below the tolerances.
